name: Sanctum Church / Funky Gospel Shout Banks

formats.wav: master, sample-accurate loop length (use for looping)
formats.mp3: 128k web version (encoder padding: not sample-accurate, avoid for loops)

license: All sounds are original synthesis created for Sanctum; no third-party samples. No attribution required.

playback.loop: Start on next bar (or beat) boundary of the transport; loop=true, loopStart=0, loopEnd=buffer.duration; playbackRate = projectBpm / pad.bpm (or time-stretch) to tempo-sync. Pads with the same chokeGroup cut each other on the next boundary.
playback.oneshot: Fire immediately on pad hit, no loop.
